name: Swimlanes, vertical
why: Each executor has a column: Agent, Human, Tool. Time goes down. Each step run is a block in its column, so a loop shows as repeated blocks with a link on the right. A NOW line marks the present. Best for who works and when. Weak for the full graph shape and for steps that never ran.

variants.label: Narrow columns, text on the side
Thin rails, NOW card in the list
